explainer.summary: Joe Milton III is a 26-year-old quarterback who played at Michigan and Tennessee and was drafted by the Patriots in 2024. He now plays for the Philadelphia Eagles.
explainer.why_now: With starter Jalen Hurts sidelined, Milton was reported in early November to be making his first NFL start for the Eagles against the Giants in Week 9.
background: The Eagles signed him off the Dallas Cowboys practice squad in October. Newsweek reported that Hurts had a superficial blood clot in his calf, and the Inquirer said the Eagles were 2-6 and on a six-game losing streak when Milton was named to replace Tanner McKee.

Milton was a sixth-round pick by New England in 2024 and was traded to Dallas in April 2025. Before this, he had appeared in five regular-season games, completing 69.8 percent of his passes for 424 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions. He is 6-foot-5 and known for arm strength.
The sources here date from early November, so they do not say how the Giants game went.

Eagles turn to former Cowboys QB after Jalen Hurts injury
